page.layout: One page of text, dedication opening; a large red title block at the top, centred; running text below in one column. No margin notes, no running head, no page number visible.

main_text.l: Vandalorúmque, nec non in Silesia Crosna & Suibusfiæ
Difficilima & deploratissima sunt, in quorum matu-
ritatem Deus, justo equidem sanctóque, sed paterno
eodem erga domum & familiam suam judicio usus,

page.notes: The title block is set in red and black roman and italic capitals; the large red "DOMINO MEO" and "FRIDERICO WILHELMO" are display type. The opening "D" is a red woodcut initial, joined to "ifficilima" as "Difficilima". Some words in the title are italic and are marked as such only in the heading text above where practical. Edge damage and stains at the left and right margins; no legible marginal text.
